headline: Shift-click removes markers again, and the Project view's buttons all carry a mark.
notes: Shift-click the marker flag removes Trace+'s markers, the same as alt-click. Either key does it, and a held key can never add markers by mistake
Delete empty bins and Put back have icons now, and the tick on All and Clear is drawn rather than typed
Fixed: the Filters popup drew a Which sequences count heading in the Project view with nothing under it. Those 2 filters belong to the clip view, so the heading only appears when they do
The search box no longer sits on top of its own magnifying glass
